architecture_summary: AI-powered Scrum management system with Claude agent automating story development through a JSON-based SDLC pipeline.

components.name: Flask Server
components.role: REST API with 66 routes serving pages and data

components.name: Sprint Board
components.role: Drag-and-drop Kanban interface for sprint items

components.name: Test Fixture
components.role: Sample app modified by agent during workflow

key_endpoints.purpose: Launch sprint — agent runs all in-sprint stories
Fetch full pipeline including backlog and sprint items
Generate unit, stories, bolts from intent + Q&A
Analyze codebase and produce architectural artifacts
Reset index.html to baseline and commit
Reset in-sprint done/failed items to pending
Current sprint item, stage, and progress
Composite health score for nav indicator

business_transactions: Add idea via Team Chat or Watercooler

code_structure.purpose: Flask API server — all routes, sprint start, inception endpoints
Live sprint view — current story, stage, streaming log
Audit log — story diffs and agent decisions
Kanban sprint board — drag-and-drop, start sprint, mark pending
System health dashboard — score, impediments, velocity
AI-DLC inception flow — intent to stories to sprint
Test fixture app modified by the agent each sprint
Team Chat + Watercooler — idea capture and intake
Prompt viewer — all agent and inception prompts
Sprint retrospective — findings and wisdom display

business_dictionary.Bolt: A suggested sprint grouping from inception — one Bolt = one Sprint run
business_dictionary.Hermes: The AI reviewer (Haiku) that runs code_review and ac_check gates after each story
business_dictionary.Inception: The AI-DLC process that decomposes an intent into Unit, Stories, Bolts via inception.html
business_dictionary.Unit: An Epic — a bounded context grouping of related stories produced by inception
business_dictionary.Sprint: A sequential batch of stories executed by the agent in one run
business_dictionary.Story: A user story with acceptance criteria that the agent implements as patches to index.html
business_dictionary.Idea: The raw instruction text for a story — mirrors story text for inception items
business_dictionary.Opportunity: An idea in the opportunity backlog — not yet elaborated into a story
business_dictionary.in_sprint: Boolean — true means the item is queued for the current sprint run
business_dictionary.sprint_number: Integer identifying which sprint batch an item ran in — used by the leaderboard
business_dictionary.Retro: Retrospective — runs automatically after each sprint, produces findings and wisdom
business_dictionary.Wisdom: Synthesized coding/AC directives from past retros — injected into future agent prompts
business_dictionary.Workspace: The codebase snapshot saved by inception for downstream context injection
